entities.summary: The Tomb of Ayyub is one of the alleged burial sites of Job. It is located in the hills overlooking the city of Salalah in Oman's Dhofar region. For other such places in Palestine,Israel, Syria, Lebanon and Turkey. see Local traditions regarding Job.
